ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because kx + b > 3$ and $y = kx + b$,\\
$\therefore y > 3$,\\
$\because$ when $y > 3$, by analyzing the graph, it is determined that the graph meeting the requirements intersects the y-axis above the given point,\\
$\therefore x < 0$, thus, the answer is: $\boxed{x < 0}$.
